# Bajaj FinServ

> > Bajaj FinServ's digital marketplace offering consumer electronics and appliances with flexible EMI financing options across India.

Bajaj FinServ operates Bajaj Mall, an e-commerce platform specializing in home appliances, electronics, and consumer goods with integrated EMI payment solutions. The platform features products from leading brands like Whirlpool, LG, Godrej, V-Guard, and others, making premium appliances accessible through easy monthly installment plans.
